Spherical Roller Bearings

Self-aligning design that accommodates heavy radial loads and shaft misalignment in continuous-duty industrial applications.

Typical Applications
Heavy industry, mining, paper mills

Cylindrical Roller Bearings

High radial load capacity with a separable design suited to high-speed applications requiring strict rotational rigidity.

Typical Applications
Gearboxes, electric motors, machine tools
Learn More

Tapered Roller Bearings

Optimised for combined radial and axial loads in heavy machinery, gearboxes and automotive driveline applications.

Typical Applications
Automotive, heavy vehicles, industrial drives

HOW WE WORK

From specification to spindle.

A disciplined four-stage process that turns engineering requirements into reliable rotational performance.

  1. 01

    Specification

    Application engineers translate operating loads, speeds and environment into a precise bearing specification.

  2. 02

    Material Selection

    Steel grade, heat treatment and lubrication strategy are chosen to match the duty cycle and lifetime targets.

  3. 03

    Manufacturing

    Tightly toleranced grinding, turning and finishing operations on calibrated machinery deliver true running surfaces.

  4. 04

    Quality & Delivery

    Each batch is inspected, traced and dispatched from the nearest hub to minimise downtime in the field.
